_comment: Pinned tool versions for the advisor loop. Re-pin quarterly, not on every release. Re-verify SHA256s when bumping. Some tools sign releases with cosign; we verify those too.

trivy._asset_naming: trivy uses Linux-64bit / Linux-ARM64 (capital L, no underscore-amd64). Template hard-codes amd64; templatize when arm64 CI is added.

cosign._comment: Cosign verifies itself with a previous cosign. For first install, fall back to GitHub release SHA256.

gitleaks._asset_naming: gitleaks publishes linux_x64 / linux_arm64 (not amd64). Template hard-codes x64; templatize when arm64 CI is added.
gitleaks._comment: Gitleaks doesn't sign releases with cosign yet; pin SHA256 from release notes.

semgrep._version_note: Bumped from 1.95.0 on 2026-05-19. 1.95.0 ships with an opentelemetry-instrumentation version that's incompatible with Python 3.12 on Ubuntu 24.04 GHA runners — pipx install succeeds but `semgrep` itself crashes at import. 1.163.0 ships a fixed dep set.

scorecard._version_note: v5.0.0 was never released; ossf jumped from 5.x prereleases to 5.5.0 (2026-04-23). Pinned at 5.5.0 on 2026-05-19.

zap._comment: OWASP ZAP runs as a container. Pin by digest, not tag. Re-verify quarterly. Use docker pull zaproxy/zap-stable && docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' to capture the current digest.

_notes_on_pin_me: Entries marked 'PINME' are placeholders. Run install-verify.sh --capture-hashes to populate them from the release artifact actually downloaded.
Each pin runs through a quarterly re-verify cycle. The CI installer refuses to proceed if a SHA256 doesn't match the pin.
